summary: This standards-track document defines a well-known BGP community called GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN. A router tags routes with it before a planned session shutdown so neighbors can prefer alternative paths first. It also describes operational procedures so that traffic moves away before the session goes down, reducing lost traffic during planned maintenance.

eli5.summary: Before closing a road for repairs, you put up a sign telling drivers to use another route. This is that sign for internet routers, so nobody drives into a closed road.

questions: what is the bgp graceful_shutdown community
how to shut down a bgp session without dropping traffic
